name: Data.Pair.ratio_eq_intAlgPart_div
summary: Divide the two instances of `Data.Pair.intAlgPart_eq_mul_L`; the constant A cancels.

steps.claim: By `Data.Pair.intAlgPart_eq_mul_L`, intAlgPart(H, ϑ)/intAlgPart(H, 1) = |L(z, (νϑ)⁻¹)|/|L(z, ν⁻¹)| (the values being positive multiples of the L-values' absolute values), which is the definition of ratio(p, ϑ).
steps.lean:
(intAlgPart_eq_mul_L H).elim fun _ ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ by
    simpa [*, ratio] using congr((‖$(h ϑ) / $(h .one)‖ : ℂ)).symm
